Calculate the moment of the girl’s weight about the pivot and show that it is close to 480 N m.

mark_scheme.text:
moment = force × distance (of direction of force from pivot)
404 × 1.2
484.8 (N m) (which is about 480 N m)

parts.text:
The plank balances horizontally when the boy pushes down with a force F at a distance of
1.6 m from the pivot.
Calculate the size of force F.
force F =  ..................................................... N [3]

mark_scheme.label: 3(b)
mark_scheme.text:
c.w. moment = a.c.w moment OR moment of weight = moment of force/F
404 × 1.2 = F × 1.6 OR (F =) 484.8 ÷ 1.6
(F = ) 300 (N)
